institutionSectors.name: Banking and payments
institutionSectors.function: Accounts, wires, custody, compliance, suspicious-activity questions and settlement lanes.
institutionSectors.records: court filings, regulator actions, bank statements, enforcement releases, settlements
institutionSectors.next: Pull regulator release, settlement language, compliance timeline and named public statements.

institutionSectors.name: Foundations and philanthropy
institutionSectors.function: Access, grants, donor-advised influence, institutional reputation and prestige routing.
institutionSectors.records: Form 990, grant database, foundation reports, university gift statements, public donor pages
institutionSectors.next: Pull 990, grant recipient, board/leadership data, donation date and public response.

institutionSectors.name: Universities and research labs
institutionSectors.function: Prestige, appointments, donations, intellectual access, event access and institutional review.
institutionSectors.records: institutional review, donor records, event pages, emails, public statements
institutionSectors.next: Pull institutional review, donation acceptance policy, names of offices involved and corrective action.

institutionSectors.name: Law firms and litigation
institutionSectors.function: Settlements, NDAs, sealing, discovery fights, denial letters and risk containment.
institutionSectors.records: court docket, motions, settlement reporting, unsealed exhibits, firm statements
institutionSectors.next: Pull docket history, motion type, sealing status, party statements and outcome.

institutionSectors.name: Media and reputation
institutionSectors.function: Narrative control, profile building, reputation repair, suppression claims and public denials.
institutionSectors.records: articles, corrections, ownership records, interviews, email archives, public statements
institutionSectors.next: Pull original article, correction history, ownership/ad relationship and counter-source.

institutionSectors.name: Technology platforms
institutionSectors.function: Identity rails, speech controls, data brokerage, AI ranking, payment access and infrastructure power.
institutionSectors.records: policy pages, transparency reports, lawsuits, regulator files, SEC filings
institutionSectors.next: Pull policy change date, enforcement data, legal challenge and opt-out details.

institutionSectors.name: Political bodies and campaigns
institutionSectors.function: Access, lobbying, donations, appointments, committee pressure and public policy outcomes.
institutionSectors.records: OpenSecrets, official campaign filings, lobbying filings, committee records, statements
institutionSectors.next: Pull donation date, committee vote/action, lobbying client, public statement and counterparty.

institutionSectors.name: Property and corporate entities

institutionSectors.records: company register, property record, court exhibit, SEC filing, ICIJ/OpenCorporates-style databases
institutionSectors.next: Pull entity name, officers, date, jurisdiction, asset link and privacy boundary.

institutionSectors.function: What was investigated, ignored, corrected, fined, sealed, delayed or referred.

moneyRoutes.name: Net worth and ownership
moneyRoutes.use: Use a dated estimate only as a starting lead, then check filings, ownership stakes and public asset records.
moneyRoutes.source: Forbes/Bloomberg-style estimates, SEC filings, company reports, court exhibits
moneyRoutes.next: Add date checked, estimate source, confidence and whether wealth is personal, family, company or foundation.

moneyRoutes.name: SEC / Form ADV / corporate filings
moneyRoutes.use: Find funds, advisers, directors, beneficial ownership, public company roles and governance links.
moneyRoutes.source: SEC EDGAR, Form ADV, public company annual reports
moneyRoutes.next: Record entity name, filing date, role, ownership signal and cross-reference to person/institution card.

moneyRoutes.name: Foundation and nonprofit money
moneyRoutes.use: Track grants, donors, board members, institutional recipients and reputation-building pathways.
moneyRoutes.source: Form 990, charity register, foundation annual report, university gift announcement
moneyRoutes.next: Add grant amount/date, recipient, program name, public explanation and conflict/boundary note.

moneyRoutes.name: Political money and lobbying
moneyRoutes.use: Map donations, PACs, lobbying clients, policy outcomes and access routes.
moneyRoutes.source: OpenSecrets, FEC/state filings, FARA/lobbying registers, committee records
moneyRoutes.next: Add donor/entity, amount, date, recipient, policy issue and source route.

moneyRoutes.name: Court money and settlements
moneyRoutes.use: Track payments, settlements, disputed claims, findings, admissions, denials and sealed records.
moneyRoutes.source: CourtListener, unsealed exhibits, settlement reporting, regulator releases
moneyRoutes.next: Separate allegation, settlement, court finding, admission, conviction and denial.

moneyRoutes.name: Property/entity lane
moneyRoutes.use: Track public entity structures and asset-control routes without publishing private addresses.
moneyRoutes.source: company registers, court exhibits, SEC filings, reputable reporting
moneyRoutes.next: Use entity names and jurisdiction; redact private home and family details.

moneyRoutes.name: Transport evidence lane
moneyRoutes.use: Use only historical public transport records where travel or logistics appears in a source file.
moneyRoutes.source: court flight logs, exhibits, registry context, published operator references
moneyRoutes.next: Separate owner, operator, charter and alleged passenger; no live personal movement board.

moneyRoutes.name: Reputation and institution access
moneyRoutes.use: Track donations, event access, board roles, media repair and institutional affiliations.
moneyRoutes.source: event pages, institutional reviews, press releases, archives, email records
moneyRoutes.next: Record date, host, purpose, public response, source type and boundary.
